description: This file declares the NativeJSImplementation class which implements the INativeJS interface for managing JavaScript applications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes method declarations for initializing, deinitializing, creating, running, and terminating applications, as well as running JavaScript code. The class maintains internal state with a render thread, a running flag, and a shared pointer to a renderer object.
external_methods: Core::hresult CreateApplication(const std::string options, uint32_t& id)
Core::hresult RunApplication(uint32_t id, const std::string url)
Core::hresult RunJavaScript(uint32_t id, const std::string code)

classes.name: NativeJSImplementation
classes.description: Implements the INativeJS interface for managing JavaScript applications within the WPEFramework plugin system. Provides methods for lifecycle management and execution of JavaScript code, with internal threading and renderer management.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the JavaScript environment with the specified Wayland display.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up and shuts down the JavaScript environment.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new JavaScript application with given options and returns its ID.

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves the list of current JavaScript applications.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs the specified JavaScript application with a given URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code within the specified application context.
